Container.Name: JobHub
Container.Overview: JobHub turns your phone's OwnTracks location data into a daily log of job-site stops and drives. Review and correct each day on your phone, record the work performed and parts used, track truck inventory, and export a PDF/JSON report. Single user, self-hosted: your location data stays on your server. Requires an OwnTracks Recorder that this container can reach. IMPORTANT: set an App password, and do not expose this container to the internet without a VPN or an authenticating reverse proxy.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the JobHub web page.

Config.Name: Data (database)
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database, which is the entire app state. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Password for the login page. Strongly recommended. Leave empty only if the app is reachable from a trusted network alone.

Config.Name: Status token
Config.Description: Optional. Lets a dashboard read counts from /api/status with this bearer token. Empty turns that address off. Make one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: All times are shown in this timezone (stored as UTC). Use an IANA name, for example America/Chicago.

Config.Name: App address (for notification links)
Config.Description: Address a Pushover notification opens when tapped, for example http://192.168.1.50:8000

Config.Name: Places provider
Config.Description: osm (free), osm_google (OSM first, Google only when OSM comes up short) or google. Can also be changed on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Google Places API key
Config.Description: Optional. Google costs money per request; see the daily cap. Can also be set on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Google daily request cap
Config.Description: Hard limit on Google requests per day.

Config.Name: Pushover app token
Config.Description: Optional. For notifications such as the no-data alert. Can also be set on the Settings page.

Config.Name: No-data alert after (min)
Config.Description: Alert when no location point arrives for this long during work hours. Keep it generous: OwnTracks may send nothing while the phone is still.

Config.Name: Work days
Config.Description: Days the no-data alert applies, for example Mon-Fri or Mon,Tue,Thu.

Config.Name: Min stop length (min)
Config.Description: Shorter visits show as dismissible short stops. Also editable on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Stop radius (m)
Config.Description: Points within this distance count as the same place. Also editable on the Settings page.
